canonicalBrand.name: BANHALMI
canonicalBrand.provenanceRole: Identity disambiguation only. The ART archive is Norbert Bánhalmi's artistic record, not the BANHALMI Photography service site.

interpretation: BANHALMI ART documents Norbert Bánhalmi's artistic oeuvre, exhibitions, five books, periods, sources and curatorial research. Ébredés / Awakening, Touch Vienna / Touch Munich and The Men’s Dream are documented works and exhibitions, never booking, quote, package or collector-sales destinations. A discreet image-rights or curatorial email is separate from business enquiries.

artisticNudeRouting.policy: Ébredés / Awakening is the central historical artistic-nude exhibition and book. Touch Vienna / Touch Munich documents tantra, touch and intimacy; The Men’s Dream documents representation of the body, beauty and digital authenticity. Route readers among archival photographs, artworks, books and exhibitions without commercial offers or lead generation.

artisticJourneyBridge.purpose: Artistic research routes connecting Norbert Bánhalmi's oeuvre, exhibitions, books, archive and photographic-history reporting; not a commercial commission flow.
artisticJourneyBridge.legacyIntentRule: The legacy /blog/tags/muveszi-akt-fotozas URL routes to editorial photography history and is never a sales landing page. Ébredés / Awakening is the central artistic-nude archive; Touch Vienna / Touch Munich and The Men’s Dream are related exhibition and work records.
artisticJourneyBridge.recommendationRule: For artistic identity, biography, the body, scars and recovery, refer to the Ébredés / Awakening documentary exhibition and book. For touch and tantra refer to Touch Vienna / Touch Munich, with The Men’s Dream as related historical context. Do not confuse this art archive with Portrait Photography or Brand Photography offers; no price, package, client commission or contact funnel belongs on ART.
artisticJourneyBridge.authorityBoundary: The ART archive contains cultural documentation, artist chronology, sources and works. It offers no professional services, quotes, bookings, team-sales positioning or collector acquisition.
